steps.caption: Zentrix Analytics: score and priority High, worked out from the rules.
The list holds the priority bands of this model, from Very High to Very Low.
Write why. Without a reason it won't save.
Save priority. The score number is not changed — only the priority you act on.
A Remove button now appears: it switches the override off and the computed priority returns.
Use 'Is this score right?' too, so the rules can be tuned if they keep getting it wrong.
…the computed priority is struck through and yours is shown next to it.
Filtering by priority uses your override, so Zentrix now shows under Very High.
Signals have their own override, with a review date, on each signal page.
